reader.requirement: At 1985 MIN must return the content of the argument-1 with the least value, least decided by the simple-condition comparison of the arguments' class: algebraic value for numeric arguments (any usage, scale, literal, arithmetic expression, ODO-bounded ALL) and the program collating sequence with space padding for alphabetic/alphanumeric arguments (elementary, edited and group data items, nonnumeric literals).

edition-consulted.switches: IntrinsicFunctionNotYetIntroduced when sig.IntroducedIn (85) exceeds DialectLevel; MIN is available at 85
NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: a numeric MIN outside an arithmetic expression is refused at 85, accepted at 2023 (an alphanumeric MIN is an identifier in both)

reader.edition-search: no edition test in IntrinsicRenderer.cs, NumericRenderer.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs, IntrinsicCatalog.cs, CobolIntrinsics.Select.cs or CobolIntrinsics.Exact.cs (grep Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel). The alphanumeric arm takes the program collating sequence through ic.Collate (CollatePrefix), set from OBJECT-COMPUTER with no edition test; the numeric lane follows the arithmetic mode, native at 85.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the value; yes at the reference site for a numeric MIN (refused at 85 outside an arithmetic expression) and in operand classes (a national operand is refused at 85)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf40_04 covers numeric literals and items and native-order alphanumeric with a padding tie; not covered: a PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE, ODO-bounded ALL, packed/binary/P-scaled items, 18-digit extremes, group and edited arguments, arithmetic-expression arguments

reader.notes: Numeric MIN selects by CobolNum.Compare over each argument at its own scale (MinAt) and rescales only the chosen value; alphanumeric MIN is ExtremeIndex over CobolString.Compare or the program's CobolCollation. Outside this RV: MIN (A1 ALL "A") and MIN (A1 SPACES) compile and run at 85 although §1989:A.2.2 AR3 admits only a data item or a nonnumeric literal (argument-rule under-rejection, ref21/ref22); kb/Work PB5781 (A (- B) parsed as a subscript) is filed on 1985-SR-VI.6.2.3-4, not this rule.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the alphanumeric arm under a PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE where the space pad does not sort lowest: ALPHABET EXCL IS "!" "B" ALSO " " "A" (pad.cob, runs/pad-001). PAD1 [A!] and PAD2 [A!] for MIN ("A" "A!") in either order (the pad space weighs above "!"; native order would give "A"); TAB1 [A!] for MIN (TE (ALL)) over "AB" "A " "A!"; LIT1 [A!] with literals. Numeric arm: scl.cob MINXX +.999999999999999998 for MIN (X * X B 1). An alphanumeric function argument (sz.cob, runs/sz-002) FN3 [AB]. The padding is with spaces weighed by the program collating sequence, as §1985 requires. OK  §1989:A.2.27.4 RV1  (2.27.4 Returned Values)  the text is in RV1; OK  §1985:VI.6.3.1.1.2  (6.3.1.1.2 Comparison of Nonnumeric Operands)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GRL2.2 ("the shorter operand were extended on the right by sufficient spaces").
